install.description: Adds Docker's apt repository and installs docker-ce pinned to the requested version plus containerd.io, docker-buildx-plugin and docker-compose-plugin; enables and starts the service. No-op when already installed at the pinned version.
install.title: Install Docker

uninstall.description: Stops the service, purges the Docker packages and removes /etc/docker, /var/lib/docker and /var/lib/containerd. No-op when not installed.
uninstall.title: Uninstall Docker

update.description: Upgrades the Docker packages within the pinned version and restarts the service. No-op when current.
update.title: Update Docker

verify.description: Read-only check that the engine is installed, the service is active and the major version matches the request. Exits non-zero when it does not.
verify.title: Verify Docker

description: Installs and manages Docker Engine (docker-ce) from Docker's distribution repository, pinned to a major or minor version, with the buildx and compose plugins. Uninstall removes the engine and its state. Targets Debian 12/13 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04.
name: docker
title: Docker
